label: Pressure Reactivity Index 0
definition: A calculated index representing the relative number of minutes with negative pressure reactivity index values.

label: Pressure Reactivity Index Index 0
definition: A derived parameter measuring the percentage of monitoring time when the Pressure Reactivity Index exceeds zero, indicating impaired autoregulation.

label: Intracranial Pressure Burden
definition: The cumulative dose of elevated intracranial pressure per patient, defined as the percentage of time in the red zone.

label: Intracranial Pressure Insult
definition: An episode of elevated intracranial pressure characterized by specific intensity and duration thresholds associated with worse neurological outcomes.

label: Intracranial Pressure Threshold
definition: A critical pressure value above which intracranial pressure is associated with worse neurological outcomes, dependent on insult duration, age, cerebral perfusion pressure, and autoregulatory status.

label: Therapy Intensity Level Scale
definition: A standardized assessment tool measuring the intensity of intracranial pressure-lowering strategies applied in traumatic brain injury management.

label: Intracranial Pressure-lowering Treatment
definition: Medical or surgical interventions aimed at reducing elevated intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Intracranial Pressure-time Burden
definition: The cumulative measure of intracranial pressure derangements calculated as the area under the intracranial pressure curve above a threshold over time, independently associated with mortality.

label: Intracranial Pressure Monitoring
definition: Continuous measurement of intracranial pressure in severe traumatic brain injury patients to guide treatment decisions.

label: Barbiturate Therapy
definition: A third-tier medical therapy using barbiturates such as thiopental to manage refractory intracranial hypertension.

label: Therapy Intensity Level (TIL)
definition: A scoring system measuring the intensity of therapeutic interventions applied in critical care management.

label: Pupil Abnormality
definition: A clinical finding indicating neurological dysfunction, defined as the presence of two unreactive pupils or anisocoria.

label: Heart Rate Variability
definition: The variation in time intervals between successive heartbeats, demonstrated to be a predictor of hypotension in critical care.

label: Intracranial Hypertension Index 20
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of time intracranial pressure exceeds 20 mm Hg.

label: Intracranial Pressure-lowering Therapy
definition: Medical or surgical interventions aimed at reducing elevated intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Time to Decompressive Craniectomy
definition: The interval between emergency department arrival and surgical decompressive craniectomy in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Intracranial Hypertension Index 25
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of time intracranial pressure exceeds 25 mm Hg.

label: Heart Rate Standard Deviation
definition: A derived feature representing the variability of heart rate measurements over a sequential time window.

label: Refractory Elevated Intracranial Pressure
definition: A clinical condition in traumatic brain injury where intracranial pressure remains uncontrollably high despite first and second-tier medical interventions.

label: Secondary Injury
definition: Injury that occurs after the initial traumatic event, potentially preventable through intracranial pressure monitoring and management.

label: Heart Rate Slope
definition: A derived feature representing the rate of change of heart rate over a sequential time window.

label: Barbiturate Administration
definition: A pharmacological intervention using barbiturates such as thiopental to manage intracranial hypertension in TBI patients.

label: Secondary Brain Injury
definition: Delayed neurological damage occurring after the initial traumatic insult, triggered by raised intracranial pressure and other physiological insults.

label: Intracranial Insult
definition: A secondary insult originating within the cranium, predominantly resulting from high intracranial pressure and ischaemic mechanisms.

label: Bifrontal Craniectomy
definition: A surgical procedure involving bilateral removal of frontal bone to reduce intracranial pressure.

label: Varying Effect on Cerebral Perfusion Pressure
definition: A heterogeneous response of cerebral perfusion pressure to decompressive craniectomy that differs among individual patients.

label: Cerebral Hypoperfusion Index 60
definition: A calculated index representing the percentage of time cerebral perfusion pressure is below 60 mm Hg.

label: Brain-protective Strategy
definition: A comprehensive management approach aimed at reducing intracranial pressure and preventing secondary ischemic injury in traumatic brain injury.

label: Intracranial Hypoperfusion Index
definition: A measure quantifying the degree and duration of inadequate cerebral blood flow.

label: Neurological Outcome
definition: The clinical status and functional recovery of a patient following traumatic brain injury, assessed at specified time points such as 6 months.

label: Secondary Ischemic Damage
definition: Brain tissue damage resulting from hypoperfusion caused by elevated intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury.

label: Intracranial Hypoperfusion Index 60
definition: A derived parameter measuring the percentage of monitoring time when cerebral perfusion pressure is below 60 mmHg.

label: Pressure-volume Compensatory Reserve
definition: The brain's capacity to accommodate changes in intracranial volume without significant increases in intracranial pressure.

label: Haemodialysis
definition: A renal replacement therapy procedure in which blood is filtered outside the body to remove waste products.

label: Spinal Anesthesia
definition: An anesthetic technique that may be associated with hypotensive episodes requiring prediction and management.

label: Intraoperative Hypotension
definition: A decrease in blood pressure occurring during surgical procedures with significant impact on patient mortality.

label: Baseline Mean Arterial Pressure
definition: The initial or reference mean arterial pressure measurement used as a predictor of hypotensive outcomes.

label: Unfavourable Neurological Outcome
definition: A clinical outcome category defined as death, vegetative state, or severe disability, corresponding to Glasgow Outcome Score categories 1-3.

label: Systemic Secondary Insult
definition: A complication affecting whole-body physiological systems, with arterial hypotension being one of the most critical types.

label: Monitoring Time
definition: The duration of continuous physiological monitoring during a patient's ICU stay, used to calculate cumulative exposure to elevated intracranial pressure.

label: Mean Arterial Blood Pressure Slope
definition: A derived feature representing the rate of change of mean arterial blood pressure over a sequential time window.

label: Extracranial Injuries
definition: Traumatic injury occurring outside the cranium in patients with traumatic brain injury, affecting overall injury severity and outcomes.

label: Systolic Arterial Blood Pressure Slope
definition: A derived feature representing the rate of change of systolic arterial blood pressure over a sequential time window.

label: Cerebral Vasomotor Reactivity
definition: The ability of cerebral blood vessels to respond to changes in intracranial pressure and other physiological stimuli.

label: Neurological Deterioration
definition: A decline in neurological function and status in patients with traumatic brain injury, influenced by intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure management.

label: Neurocognitive Scores
definition: Standardized assessments measuring cognitive function and neuropsychological outcomes following brain injury.

label: Severe Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A serious head injury resulting from blunt or penetrating trauma, characterized by significant neurological dysfunction and requiring intensive monitoring and management.

label: Septic Shock
definition: A life-threatening condition of severe infection with hypotension requiring urgent antimicrobial therapy.

label: Blood Pressure Mean
definition: The average blood pressure calculated across the cardiac cycle, representing overall perfusion pressure.

label: Systolic Arterial Blood Pressure
definition: A physiological parameter measuring the maximum arterial pressure during ventricular contraction, calculated as a mean value over a time window.

label: Mortality Rate
definition: The proportion of patients who died during the follow-up period.

label: Mechanical Ventilation
definition: A therapeutic intervention providing artificial respiratory support in intensive care unit patients.

label: Standard Medical Treatment
definition: Conservative medical management of traumatic brain injury without surgical decompression.

label: Clinical Effectiveness
definition: The degree to which a medical intervention produces beneficial outcomes in real-world clinical practice.

label: Peripheral Arterial Blood Pressure Waveform
definition: A continuous physiological measurement of blood pressure variation obtained from peripheral arterial monitoring.

label: Blood Pressure Systolic
definition: The maximum pressure exerted by blood on arterial walls during heart contraction.

label: Baseline Risk Factor
definition: Clinical and demographic variables collected at admission used to characterize patient risk profile, including age, gender, and neurological assessments.

label: Cranioplasty
definition: A surgical procedure to repair or reconstruct the skull, often performed after decompressive craniectomy.

label: Third-tier Intervention
definition: A medical or surgical intervention applied as a last resort when first and second-tier treatments fail to control intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury.

label: Traumatic Intracranial Hypertension
definition: Elevated intracranial pressure resulting from traumatic brain injury, a serious secondary insult requiring intervention.

label: Second-tier Intervention
definition: A medical intervention applied when first-tier treatments fail to control intracranial pressure in traumatic brain injury management.

label: Primary Brain Damage
definition: The initial structural injury to the brain caused by traumatic impact.

label: Unacceptably High Intracranial Pressure
definition: A clinical threshold of intracranial pressure that exceeds safe limits and requires escalation of treatment in traumatic brain injury management.

label: Cerebral Ischaemia
definition: A pathological state of inadequate cerebral blood flow and oxygen delivery to brain tissue, a potential consequence of excessively low cerebral perfusion pressure.

label: First-tier Intervention
definition: Initial management strategies for traumatic brain injury including head elevation, sedation, analgesia, and maintenance of normal temperature and carbon dioxide levels.

label: Injury Mechanism
definition: A type of traumatic injury mechanism resulting in brain injury.

label: Malignant Intracranial Pressure Course
definition: A clinical pattern of progressive or uncontrollable intracranial pressure elevation despite medical management in traumatic brain injury.

label: Multimodality Monitoring
definition: A clinical approach using multiple monitoring modalities to assess physiological status and guide management decisions in traumatic brain injury patients.

label: Lobar Intracerebral Haemorrhage
definition: Bleeding within the cerebral lobes of the brain.

label: Bifrontal Procedure
definition: A surgical procedure involving bilateral frontal decompression to relieve intracranial pressure.

label: Bilateral Fixed and Dilated Pupils
definition: A severe neurological sign indicating brainstem injury or herniation, used as an exclusion criterion in traumatic brain injury studies.

label: Sports-related Injury
definition: A type of traumatic injury mechanism occurring during sports activities, resulting in brain injury.

label: Acute Hypotensive Episodes
definition: Sudden, severe drops in blood pressure occurring in intensive care patients that can be predicted using clinical data analysis.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A severe neurological condition characterized by impaired cerebrovascular autoregulation and secondary brain injury, requiring intensive monitoring and management.

label: Blood Pressure Diastolic
definition: The minimum pressure exerted by blood on arterial walls during heart relaxation.

label: Pressure-time Dose
definition: A clinical concept quantifying the cumulative exposure to elevated intracranial pressure over time, considering both intensity and duration of pressure insults.

label: Disability Assessment
definition: Evaluation of functional impairment and disability resulting from traumatic brain injury.

label: Median Mean Intracranial Pressure
definition: The median value of mean intracranial pressure measurements over a specified monitoring period in traumatic brain injury.

label: Upper Good Recovery
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating excellent functional recovery with minimal or no residual symptoms.

label: Lower Good Recovery
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating good functional recovery with minor residual symptoms.

label: Vegetative State
definition: A severe neurological outcome characterized by wakefulness without awareness, representing an unfavorable outcome in TBI patients.

label: Head Injury
definition: A clinical condition resulting from trauma to the head, for which the cumulative duration of arterial hypotensive events is a prognostic factor for clinical outcome.

label: Cerebrovascular Autoregulation
definition: The physiological mechanism by which the brain maintains constant cerebral blood flow despite changes in systemic blood pressure, influencing optimal individual cerebral perfusion pressure targets.

label: Warning Time
definition: The duration in advance of a hypotensive event that a predictive system provides notification to clinical staff.

label: Head Position
definition: The patient's body positioning during monitoring, specifically elevation of the head, which affects intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion pressure measurements.

label: Passive Autoregulation
definition: A state in which cerebrovascular autoregulation is impaired and cerebral blood flow becomes pressure-dependent.

label: Supratentorial Intracerebral Haemorrhage
definition: Bleeding within the brain tissue located above the tentorium cerebelli.

label: Vital Signs Monitoring Data
definition: Continuously recorded physiological measurements of vital parameters used to detect clinical events and artifacts in intensive care.

label: Insult Duration
definition: A quantitative measure of the time period over which an intracranial pressure insult persists, expressed in minutes.

label: ICP Insult
definition: An episode of elevated intracranial pressure defined by specific intensity and duration thresholds, classified as active or passive based on autoregulation status.

label: General Anesthesia
definition: A medical procedure involving induced unconsciousness, during which hypotensive episodes have been studied as predictors of outcome.

label: Intensity Threshold
definition: A critical pressure value in millimeters of mercury used to define elevated intracranial pressure episodes.

label: Active Autoregulation
definition: A state in which cerebrovascular autoregulation is functioning to maintain stable cerebral blood flow.

label: Ischaemic Mechanism
definition: A pathological process involving reduced blood flow to brain tissue, contributing to secondary insults.

label: Active ICP Insult
definition: An intracranial pressure insult episode where the average low-frequency autoregulation index is negative or zero, indicating impaired autoregulation.

label: Sex
definition: A demographic variable representing patient biological sex.

label: Modified Glasgow Outcome Score
definition: An adapted version of the Glasgow Outcome Score used specifically for paediatric patients to account for developmental differences.

label: Non-evacuated Mass Lesion
definition: A focal collection of blood or tissue within the brain that has not been surgically removed.

label: Absolute Reduction in Intracranial Pressure
definition: The numerical decrease in intracranial pressure values measured before and after a therapeutic intervention.

label: Severe Head Trauma
definition: A traumatic brain injury of severe degree with significant impact on patient outcomes when combined with physiological instability.

label: CPP Target
definition: A clinically specified range or threshold for cerebral perfusion pressure aimed at optimizing cerebral blood flow and preventing secondary brain injury.

label: Severe Disability
definition: A functional outcome category indicating significant impairment in activities of daily living and independence.

label: Extended Core Mortality Score
definition: An extended component of the IMPACT prognostic model incorporating additional variables to predict six-month mortality in traumatic brain injury.

label: Lower Severe Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating severe functional impairment with some awareness and limited independence.

label: Non-significant Reduction
definition: A decrease in a measured parameter that does not achieve statistical significance at the chosen alpha level.

label: Deepened Sedation
definition: A first-tier and second-tier management strategy involving increased sedative medication to reduce intracranial pressure and metabolic demand.

label: Lower Moderate Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating moderate functional impairment with some dependence on others.

label: Mortality
definition: Death outcome in traumatic brain injury patients, associated with elevated intracranial pressure and intracranial pressure-time burden.

label: Percentage Time Intracranial Pressure Above Threshold
definition: A derived parameter measuring the proportion of monitoring time when intracranial pressure exceeds a specified threshold value.

label: Good Recovery
definition: A favorable outcome category in traumatic brain injury with minimal or no functional impairment.

label: Six-month Outcome Assessment
definition: A clinical evaluation of functional recovery and neurological status performed six months after traumatic brain injury and surgical intervention.

label: EUSIG Grade
definition: A physiological adverse event scoring system used to record and define arterial hypotension events.

label: Pragmatic Decision-making
definition: Clinical decision-making in real-world practice that tailors treatment combinations to individual patient circumstances rather than following strict protocols.

label: TBI Guidelines
definition: Clinical practice guidelines providing evidence-based recommendations for the management of traumatic brain injury, including cerebral perfusion pressure targets.

label: Duration Threshold
definition: A time interval in minutes above which intracranial pressure elevation is associated with worse neurological outcome.

label: Pedestrian Injury
definition: A type of traumatic injury mechanism in which a pedestrian is struck, resulting in brain injury.

label: 6-month Outcome
definition: The neurological status and functional outcome measured at six months following traumatic brain injury.

label: Diffuse Injury
definition: Widespread traumatic injury affecting multiple brain regions without a focal mass lesion.

label: Passive ICP Insult
definition: An intracranial pressure insult episode where the average low-frequency autoregulation index is positive, indicating preserved autoregulation.

label: Extended Core Unfavorable Outcome Score
definition: An extended component of the IMPACT prognostic model incorporating additional variables to predict six-month unfavorable outcome in traumatic brain injury.

label: Gender
definition: A demographic variable representing patient sex, used as a baseline risk factor in outcome analysis.

label: Upper Moderate Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating moderate functional impairment with greater independence than lower moderate disability.

label: Impact Model
definition: A prognostic model incorporating core variables for outcome prediction in neurologically injured patients.

label: Red Zone
definition: A clinical monitoring zone representing intracranial pressure values above a critical threshold associated with worse neurological outcomes.

label: Trend of Reduction
definition: A statistical pattern indicating a directional change in a physiological parameter that does not reach statistical significance.

label: Insult Intensity
definition: A quantitative measure of the magnitude of intracranial pressure elevation during an insult episode, expressed in mmHg.

label: Quality of Life
definition: A measure of patient well-being and functional status following traumatic brain injury.

label: Insult Grading Classification
definition: A standardized classification system for categorizing secondary insults in critically ill patients.

label: Hyperosmolar Molecules
definition: A second-tier therapeutic intervention using osmotic agents to reduce intracranial pressure in severe traumatic brain injury.

label: Upper Severe Disability
definition: A Glasgow Outcome Scale outcome category indicating severe functional impairment with greater independence than lower severe disability.

label: Moderate Disability
definition: An outcome category in traumatic brain injury with moderate functional impairment.

label: Age
definition: A demographic variable representing patient age at admission, used as a baseline risk factor and core variable in outcome prediction models.

label: CRASH Mortality Score
definition: A component of the CRASH prognostic model predicting 14-day mortality risk in traumatic brain injury.

label: Crash Score
definition: A prognostic model predicting unfavorable outcome in TBI patients based on admission data.
